def ppos(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    bl=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='b']
    # exclude HUD (rows<6)
    bl=[(r,c) for r,c in bl if r>=6]
    if not bl: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in bl]; cs=[c for r,c in bl]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
def redinfo(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    red=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='R']
    rs=[r for r,c in red]; cs=[c for r,c in red]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(red))

def ppos(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    bl=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='b']
    # exclude HUD (rows<6)
    bl=[(r,c) for r,c in bl if r>=6]
    if not bl: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in bl]; cs=[c for r,c in bl]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
def redinfo(f):
    g=[list(r) for r in f.ascii.split('\n')]
    red=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if g[r][c]=='R']
    rs=[r for r,c in red]; cs=[c for r,c in red]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),len(red))
